SelectText inputs

The `m3e-select` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Basic usage

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.formField []
[ M3e.FormField.label (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "select1" ] [ Kit.text "Favorite fruit" ])
, M3e.select [ M3e.Attributes.id "select1" ]
…
[ M3e.option [] [ Kit.text "Apples" ]
, M3e.option [] [ Kit.text "Oranges" ]
, M3e.option [] [ Kit.text "Bananas" ]
, M3e.option [] [ Kit.text "Grapes" ]
]
]
M3e.FormField.view []
[ M3e.FormField.label (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "select1" ] [ Kit.text "Favorite fruit" ])
, M3e.Select.el { content = M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Apples" ] }
[ M3e.Attributes.id "select1" ]
…
[ M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Oranges" ]
, M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Bananas" ]
, M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Grapes" ]
]
]
M3e.FormField.build
|> M3e.FormField.withLabel (TypedHtml.label [ Native.attribute "for" "select1" ] [ Kit.text "Favorite fruit" ])
|> M3e.FormField.withChild
(M3e.Select.view [ M3e.Attributes.id "select1" ]
…
[ M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Apples" ]
, M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Oranges" ]
, M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Bananas" ]
, M3e.Option.view [] [ Kit.text "Grapes" ]
]
)
|> M3e.FormField.toElement
<m3e-form-field>
<label slot="label" for="select1">Favorite fruit</label>
<m3e-select id="select1">
…
<m3e-option>Apples</m3e-option>
<m3e-option>Oranges</m3e-option>
<m3e-option>Bananas</m3e-option>
<m3e-option>Grapes</m3e-option>
</m3e-select>
</m3e-form-field>

API
Types
type Is

The kind row m3e-select produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type ArrowSlot

The kinds the arrow slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.
